component.name: Compositor
component.summary: Free, open-source image editor for compositing and photo work

description.p: Compositor is a layer-based image editor built around a Photoshop-style compositing workflow: layers and folders with every Photoshop blend mode, layer masks, clipping masks, adjustment layers, non-destructive transforms, selections and painting tools.
This is the Linux edition of the macOS app by Robbie Tilton. It opens and saves the same .comp projects, so work moves freely between the two.
